sections.title: Priority, overflow and a footer for what is hidden
sections.summary: DNS records. The key column never hides; the SPF value wraps at its separators; the cache path is shortened in the middle; low-priority columns hide first and the footer names them.
points: Priority, MinWidth and MaxWidth per column
Wrap with MaxLines, Truncate, TruncateMiddle or Never
A footer such as +2 columns (TTL, Cache file)
sections.csharp:
const string Cache = "/var/cache/dns/evotec.xyz/";
Table table = new Table()
    .WithTitle("[bold]evotec.xyz[/] [muted]· DNS records via Cloudflare DoH[/]")
    .AddColumn("Name", c => c
        .WithIsKey()
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.TruncateMiddle)
        .WithMinWidth(10))
    .AddColumn("Type", c => c.WithPriority(9).WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.Never))
    .AddColumn("TTL", c => c.WithPriority(2).WithPresenter(new DurationPresenter()))
    .AddColumn("Data", c => c
        .WithPriority(10)
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.Wrap)
        .WithMaxLines(3)
        .WithFlexible()
        .WithMinWidth(28))
    .AddColumn("Latency", c => c
        .WithPriority(3)
        .WithPresenter(new NumberPresenter("ms"))
        .AddRoleRules(RoleRule.Above(100, ThemeToken.Warn)))
    .AddColumn("Cache file", c => c
        .WithPriority(1)
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.TruncateMiddle)
        .WithMinWidth(20)
        .WithMaxWidth(36));
table.AddValues("evotec.xyz", "A", 300, "104.21.48.12", 12, Cache + "A.json");
table.AddValues("evotec.xyz", "AAAA", 300, "2606:4700:3036::6815:300c", 14, Cache + "AAAA.json");
// … 4 more lines in the full program
table.AddValues("evotec.xyz", "CAA", 3600, "0 issue \"letsencrypt.org\"", 15, Cache + "CAA.json");
Terminal.Write(table);

sections.title: Groups, subtotals and totals
sections.summary: An assessment run summary grouped by target type, with subtotals, a totals row and a score drawn as a data bar inside the cell.
points: Sum, Count, Average, Min and Max per column
A data bar presenter in a cell
sections.csharp:
Table table = new Table()
    .WithTitle("[bold]Nightly checks[/] [muted]· run summary[/]")
    .WithShowSubtotals()
    .WithShowTotals()
    .AddColumn("Target", c => c
        .WithIsKey()
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.TruncateMiddle)
        .WithMinWidth(12))
    .AddColumn("Result", c => c.WithPriority(10).WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Status))
    .AddColumn("Passed", c => c
        .WithPriority(8)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Number)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum))
    .AddColumn("Failed", c => c
        .WithPriority(9)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Number)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum)
        .AddRoleRules(RoleRule.Above(0, ThemeToken.Fail)))
    .AddColumn("Warnings", c => c
        .WithPriority(6)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Number)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum)
        .AddRoleRules(RoleRule.Above(0, ThemeToken.Warn)))
    .AddColumn("Duration", c => c
        .WithPriority(4)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Duration)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum))
    .AddColumn("Score", c => c
        .WithPriority(2)
        .WithPresenter(new DataBarPresenter(100, new NumberPresenter("%")))
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Average));
table.AddGroup("Domains");
table.AddValues("ad.adatum.com", StatusKind.Fail, 9, 2, 5, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(24), 56);
table.AddValues("eu.ad.adatum.com", StatusKind.Fail, 13, 1, 1, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(16), 87);
// … 5 more lines in the full program
table.AddValues("DC09.eu.ad.adatum.com", StatusKind.Pass, 30, 0, 0, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15), 100);
Terminal.Write(table);

sections.title: Bytes, relative dates and top N
sections.summary: Build artifacts: sizes in bytes, build times, relative dates against a fixed clock, and the first five of 1,234 rows.
points: MaxRows with TotalRowCount prints Showing 5 of 1,234
Numbers follow the culture; the site renders en-US
sections.csharp:
// Relative dates are measured from a fixed time, so this example prints the same every day.
DateTimeOffset now = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 10, 16, 14, 30, 0, TimeSpan.FromHours(2));
const string Root = @"D:\Builds\ConsoleMonster\Packed\";
Table table = new Table()
    .WithTitle("[bold]Build artifacts[/] [muted]· ConsoleMonster 2.0.0[/]")
    .WithShowTotals()
    .WithMaxRows(5)
    .WithTotalRowCount(1234)
    .WithPresentation(p => p.Now = now)
    .AddColumn("Artifact", c => c.WithIsKey().WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.Never))
    .AddColumn("Kind", c => c.WithPriority(3))
    .AddColumn("Size", c => c
        .WithPriority(9)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Bytes)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum))
    .AddColumn("Built in", c => c
        .WithPriority(6)
        .WithPresenter(CellPresenters.Duration)
        .WithAggregate(ColumnAggregate.Sum))
    .AddColumn("Created", c => c
        .WithPriority(4)
        .WithPresenter(new DatePresenter(DateDisplay.Relative)))
    .AddColumn("Path", c => c
        .WithPriority(1)
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.TruncateMiddle)
        .WithMinWidth(20)
        .WithMaxWidth(40))
    .AddColumn("SHA256", c => c
        .WithPriority(0)
        .WithOverflow(ColumnOverflow.Truncate)
        .WithMaxWidth(14));
table.AddValues("ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.nupkg", "NuGet", 1_482_113L, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(48.2), now.AddMinutes(-12), Root + "ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.nupkg", "9f2c4e81a7d03b6e");
table.AddValues("ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.snupkg", "Symbols", 402_331L, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3.1), now.AddMinutes(-12), Root + "ConsoleMonster.2.0.0.snupkg", "41ab09cd77e2f310");
// … 3 more lines in the full program
table.AddValues("Docs.zip", "Docs", 51_302L, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.2), now.AddDays(-9), Root + "Docs.zip", "5d6e7f8091a2b3c4");
Terminal.Write(table);
